SELECT , (SELECT wh.original_emp_id FROM sgtransit_withdrawal_id_history wh WHERE wh.emp_no=sgtransit_employee.emp_no ORDER BY wh.history_no DESC LIMIT 1) AS withdrawal_original_id FROM sgtransit_employee
ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sgtransit_employee ( emp_id, emp_password, emp_name, emp_email, emp_phone, emp_address, emp_role, emp_status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{empId}, #{empPassword}, #{empName}, #{empEmail}, #{empPhone}, #{empAddress}, #{empRole}, #{empStatus}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE sgtransit_employee SET emp_password=#{empPassword}, emp_name=#{empName}, emp_email=#{empEmail}, emp_phone=#{empPhone}, emp_address=#{empAddress}, emp_role=#{empRole}, emp_status=#{empStatus}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE emp_no=#{empNo}
UPDATE sgtransit_employee SET emp_id=#{withdrawnId}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE emp_id=#{empId} AND emp_status='N'
